description: Implement read-only view mode in JournalEditorPage.vue. When route is /journal/:id (not /new), start in view mode showing the saved entry in notebook composition. Left page: title (Caveat font, large), date, mood emoji+label, location, story (readable line-height, paragraph breaks preserved). Right page: photos in Polaroid frames with rotation, tags as decorative labels. Add 'Back to Journal' and 'Edit Entry' buttons. Fetch entry if not in store. Handle loading, not-found, and error states with designed fallbacks. No editing controls visible in view mode.
steps: In c:\Users\Juan Miguel\Cronevia\frontend\src\pages\JournalEditorPage.vue, add reactive ref `mode` with type 'view' | 'edit'. Initialize: if entryId exists, mode = 'view'; else mode = 'edit'.
Wrap the entire existing form template in a v-if="mode === 'edit'" block to conditionally show edit UI.

Create a new v-else-if="mode === 'view'" block that uses NotebookSpread and NotebookPage components. Left page slot: render entry title (h1, font-family Caveat, size ~2.5rem, color warm brown), date (formatted, small), mood emoji + label (if present), location with pin icon (if present), and story content (preserve line breaks with white-space: pre-wrap or v-for over paragraphs split by \n\n). Right page slot: render photos using ScrapbookPhoto with small random rotations (-3 to +3 degrees), and tags as small decorative pill labels. Add 2-3 ScrapbookDecoration elements scattered with aria-hidden, positioned absolutely to avoid blocking text.

Add view mode action bar: 'Back to Journal' RouterLink (to /journal) and 'Edit Entry' button that sets mode.value = 'edit'. Place at top or bottom of notebook, styled to match scrapbook aesthetic (handwritten font for Edit button?).
Ensure existing onMounted logic fetches the entry via API if not in store (already implemented lines 145-153), handle loading state with a subtle spinner or skeleton on the notebook pages.
Add error state UI: if fetch fails, show message on notebook page 'Entry not found' or 'Unable to load entry' with a 'Back to Journal' link. Use warm, friendly error styling.
Preserve authorization: if API returns 403/401, show 'You don't have permission to view this entry' and redirect after 2 seconds.
Test: navigate directly to /journal/:id with a valid ID, verify view mode displays; click Edit Entry, verify it switches to edit mode in-place (no route change).
acceptance_criteria: Opening /journal/:id starts in view mode showing saved entry in notebook layout
View mode displays title, date, mood, location, story, photos, and tags without editing controls
Photos appear in Polaroid frames with subtle rotation on the right page
'Edit Entry' button switches to edit mode without changing the URL
Not-found or error states display clear, friendly messages
verification: Run `npm run build` from frontend/ — TypeScript compilation succeeds
Start dev server, create a new entry via /journal/new with title, story, mood, location, and photos, save it. Note the entry ID from the redirect.
Navigate to /journal/:id — verify view mode displays the saved entry in notebook layout with all fields visible and photos displayed
Click 'Edit Entry' — verify UI switches to edit mode showing the same form as before
Navigate to /journal/nonexistent-id — verify error state displays
